source.author: verg
source.text: Thybris ea fluvium, quam longa est, nocte tumentem leniit, et tacita refluens ita substitit unda, mitis ut in morem stagni placidaeque paludis sterneret aequor aquis, remo ut luctamen abesset.
source.text_original: Thybris ea fluvium, quam longa est, nocte tumentem / leniit, et tacita refluens ita substitit unda, / mitis ut in morem stagni placidaeque paludis / sterneret aequor aquis, remo ut luctamen abesset.
source.text_english: The Tiber calmed that river swollen through the whole night, and, flowing back in silence, so came to rest that, gentle in the manner of a still pool and placid marsh, it spread the surface with waters, so that there was no struggle for the oar.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: licet in morem stagni fusum aequor arrideat, licet uix summa iacentis elementi spiritu terga crispentur, magnus hic campus montes habet, intus inclusum est periculum, intus est hostis.
reuse.text_original: licet in morem stagni fusum aequor arrideat, licet uix summa iacentis elementi spiritu terga crispentur, magnus hic campus montes habet, intus inclusum est periculum, intus est hostis.
reuse.text_english: Though the expanse, spread out like a pool, may smile, though the backs of the lying element are scarcely rippled by the breeze at the surface, this broad plain has mountains; danger is enclosed within, within is the enemy.
